title: Link gap: sites that link to your competitors, not to you

yourDomain.title: Your domain
yourDomain.description: Your site. Its referring domains are left out, so you get the sites that link to your competitors and not to you.

domains.title: Competitors
domains.description: Up to 20 competitor domains or URLs, one per line.

maxReferrersPerDomain.title: Referring domains compared per competitor
maxReferrersPerDomain.description: How many of each competitor's strongest referring domains to compare with yours (up to 100,000). More = a longer, deeper list.

minAuthority.title: Minimum Open Authority
minAuthority.description: Return only sites scoring at least this (0-100). 0 = every site.

excludeHubs.title: Leave out hubs
excludeHubs.description: Leave out infrastructure (CDNs, hosts of user content, link shorteners) and sites that link to more than 30,000 domains, such as the biggest platforms. They link to everyone, so they are rarely outreach prospects.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Maximum rows to return (and pay for).
